title: Paper v2 auto-creates manifest minute policy as BACKTEST_VALIDATED execution policy without explicit evidence
description: ValidatedExecutionPolicy records must be created from explicit backtest or simulation evidence. PaperTradingV2PortfolioService._ensure_default_manifest_execution_policy currently normalizes manifest.minute_execution_policy, creates manifest_default_execution_policy when no policy exists, and marks it source_backtest_status=BACKTEST_VALIDATED with paper_enabled=True. This can convert manifest runtime fields into paper-approved execution authority without a durable proof object.
required_verification: Creating a paper portfolio without an explicit validated execution policy fails and does not create a manifest_default_execution_policy.
Creating Paper v2 / MiniQMTSim portfolios with an explicit paper_enabled validated execution policy still succeeds.
StrategyPackage execution-policy creation rejects unsuccessful source backtest evidence.
Tests still reject raw paper-only execution overrides and unknown fallback algos.
Runs persist the validated policy id/hash/json and source evidence used.
Frontend portfolio and MiniQMTSim create flows require a selected paper-enabled validated execution policy instead of relying on manifest auto-import.
Design-compliance matrix confirms manifest minute policy is not treated as automatic Paper/MiniQMT execution authority.
closure_requirements: ValidatedExecutionPolicy creation requires explicit evidence or a verified import path.
Manifest minute policy is not treated as automatic paper-approved execution authority.
GitHub issue #111 and local BUG-092 registry stay linked and status-synced.
